function mixed(input: string | { a: number }) {
  for (const key in input) console.log(key);
}
function numeric(input: number | { a: number }) {
  for (const key in input) console.log(key);
}
function nullable(input: null | undefined) {
  for (const key in input) console.log(key);
}
function voidMember(input: void | { a: number }) {
  for (const key in input) console.log(key);
}
function genericKey<T>(input: keyof T) {
  for (const key in input) console.log(key);
}
